AboutPage.metaTitle: About REMAX Altitud — Costa Rica's Southern Zone
AboutPage.metaDescription: Learn about REMAX Altitud and Altitud Cero — the premier real estate team serving Pérez Zeledón, Dominical, and Uvita.
AboutPage.intro: REMAX Altitud and REMAX Altitud Cero unite two offices under one promise: guide international and local clients through buying, selling, and investing in Costa Rica's Southern Zone — in the language they prefer.
AboutPage.officesIntro: Two offices, one team — covering the mountains of Pérez Zeledón and the Pacific coast from Dominical to Uvita.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: Turn curiosity into confidence. Whether you're exploring mountain living, beachfront rentals, or long-term investments, our agents know the terrain, the paperwork, and the culture — and we speak your language.

VipBuyerPage.metaTitle: Find Your Dream Property - REMAX Altitud
VipBuyerPage.metaDescription: Exclusive Property Search Service: You describe the life you want, we'll show you where it can happen. We’ll help you discover the place in Costa Rica that truly fits your life.

hero.title: Exclusive Property Search Service
hero.subtitle: You describe the life you want, we'll show you where it can happen. We’ll help you discover the place in Costa Rica that truly fits your life. From your first call to the moment you find your home, our process blends local expertise, curated experiences, and a clear plan from day one.

howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Moving to Costa Rica is exciting, but it can also feel overwhelming. That’s why we designed a process that makes it simple, personal, and strategic.

step1.title: Introductory Discovery Call
step1.body: You don’t need to know Costa Rica; that’s our job. Tell us what kind of life you imagine, your budget, and your timeline, and we’ll show you the best regions that match your lifestyle.

step2.title: Shortlist and Strategy
step2.body: We map out the areas and properties that truly fit your needs, not just what appears online. Each recommendation comes from local agents who actually live there.

step3.title: On-the-Ground Experience
step3.body: Visit properties in person or join live virtual tours. Discover each area’s rhythm, community, and potential.

step4.title: Decision and Next Steps
step4.body: From offers and due diligence to trusted attorneys, banks, and builders. We guide you with clarity and confidence.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: A clear, guided start to your Costa Rica journey.
premium.bestFor: Best for: Early planning, clarity, and a focused start.
premium.bullet1: Discovery Call: Share your goals, budget, and lifestyle. You don’t need to know Costa Rica. We’ll help you understand where you’ll actually find what you want.
premium.bullet2: Local Insight Plan: After our first call, we’ll define the right local agents from the areas that best fit your vision.
premium.bullet3: Tailored Shortlist: Review hand-picked properties together online, with transparent answers about costs, process, and timelines.
premium.bullet4: Next-Step Plan: Move forward confidently. Visit in person or let us tour properties via live video calls.

vip.name: VIP White-Glove
vip.description: For those ready to move with purpose and ease. Everything included in Premium, plus full concierge coordination:
vip.bestFor: Best for: Serious movers who want an end-to-end, time-efficient experience.
vip.bullet1: Private airport pickup (Chauffeur or Charter Flight option)
vip.bullet2: Accommodation coordination (Stay near your areas of interest)
vip.bullet3: Curated property & neighborhood tours (with lifestyle stops)
vip.bullet4: School visits & meetings arranged for you
vip.bullet5: Local appointments (With attorneys, banks, builders and inspectors)
vip.bullet7: Decision support with comparable analysis and offer strategy

whyChooseUs.heading: Why Buyers Choose Us
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Because buying property in Costa Rica should feel exciting, not confusing. Let’s make it simple, and unforgettable.
